title: Khushi Kapoor to Lead Mom 2, Sequel to Sridevi's Final Film
excerpt: Boney Kapoor's sequel to the National Award-winning 2017 thriller stars Khushi Kapoor alongside Karishma Tanna and Jisshu Sengupta, with a theatrical release targeted for late 2026.
body:
• Khushi Kapoor stars as the lead in Mom 2, the sequel to her late mother Sridevi's 2017 National Award-winning thriller Mom.
  • The film is directed by Girish Kohli, who co-wrote the original, and co-stars Karishma Tanna and Bengali actor Jisshu Sengupta.
  • Mom 2 is the first film shot at the new International Film City on the Yamuna Expressway near Greater Noida.
  • Producer Boney Kapoor is targeting a theatrical release for November 2026.

Khushi Steps Into Sridevi's Legacy

Khushi Kapoor, the younger daughter of the late Sridevi and producer Boney Kapoor, will headline Mom 2, the sequel to the 2017 crime thriller that earned her mother a posthumous National Film Award for Best Actress. The film, which has been in production since late 2025, is being targeted for a theatrical release in November 2026, according to India Today.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=6w6LYh4qjPc

The sequel is directed by Girish Kohli, who served as the screenwriter and co-story writer on the original Mom. Kohli made his directorial debut with the Sohum Shah-starrer Crazxy. Boney Kapoor is producing alongside Akshai Puri.

"I have watched all of Khushi's films. I am planning a film with her too. She is trying to follow in the footsteps of her mother. Her mother was the top star in all the languages she worked in. I hope Khushi and Janhvi succeed in this same level of perfection."

— Boney Kapoor, Producer

Cast and Production Details

Alongside Khushi, the film features Karishma Tanna and Bengali actor Jisshu Sengupta in prominent roles. According to Bollywood Hungama, shooting commenced on October 26, 2025 in Mumbai, shortly after Diwali. Production later moved to the newly inaugurated International Film City along the Yamuna Expressway near Greater Noida, making Mom 2 the first film to shoot at the facility.

https://x.com/NDTVProfit/status/2081733558624784542

Boney Kapoor first confirmed the project at the 25th IIFA Awards held in Jaipur in March 2025, where he publicly hinted at casting Khushi in a sequel to Mom. Sources at the time indicated he planned a formal announcement around his birthday on November 11, 2025.

The action sequences are being choreographed by Vijayan, a well-known South Indian action director. Filmfare reported that the production draws technicians from across India's regional film industries, reflecting a pan-Indian approach to the project.

The Weight of the Original

The 2017 Mom, directed by Ravi Udyawar, was a gripping revenge thriller that followed Devki, a mother who takes justice into her own hands after her stepdaughter suffers a brutal assault. The film starred Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Akshaye Khanna in key supporting roles, alongside Pakistani actors Sajal Aly and Adnan Siddiqui.

It was Sridevi's 300th and final film before her death in February 2018. Her performance earned the National Film Award for Best Actress posthumously at the 65th National Film Awards, cementing the film's place in Bollywood history.

According to a PeepingMoon report cited by MensXP, Mom 2 will share the original's genre and thematic focus on vigilante justice but may not be a direct narrative continuation. The sequel's title leverages the established brand while charting its own story.

A Pivotal Role for Khushi

For Khushi Kapoor, Mom 2 represents her most significant role to date. Her filmography so far includes The Archies (2023), Loveyapa, and Nadaaniyan — projects that received mixed critical and audience reception. The sequel offers a character-driven lead role that differs substantially from her earlier work.

The casting choice has drawn polarized reactions online. Leaked set photos showing Khushi alongside Karishma Tanna generated widespread social media discussion, with some fans expressing enthusiasm about continuing Sridevi's legacy and others questioning whether the original should be revisited.

Diaspora Interest and What's Ahead

For Sridevi's global fan base, the project carries deep emotional significance. The original Mom performed strongly in international markets, particularly among Indian diaspora audiences who followed Sridevi's four-decade career across multiple language industries.

With principal photography well underway and post-production expected through mid-2026, the November 2026 theatrical window would place Mom 2 in a competitive holiday season slot. Boney Kapoor is also developing No Entry 2, the sequel to the 2005 comedy hit, though that project's timeline remains less defined. For now, all eyes remain on whether Khushi Kapoor can deliver a performance worthy of the franchise her mother made iconic.
